scope: Targeted GCC people refresh: managers, programme leaders, architects, leads and developers; Bengaluru placement checked separately.
methodology: Manually reviewed public LinkedIn search-index pages, distinguishing own profile text and authored posts from reactions to other people.
Direct LinkedIn attempts encountered HTTP 999, HTTP 429, robots denial or unavailable cached pages; no signed-in profile scraping or access-control bypass was used.
Role groups reflect stated roles or explicitly labelled historical work. Certifications alone do not become current job titles.
First Citizens, ANZ and Wells Fargo customer programme evidence was cross-checked against official Pega pages.
No reporting lines, team sizes or job openings were inferred from staff changes. No private contact data collected.
Additive observations only; preserve all older people, company profiles and their provenance.
